subject: SOC 2 re-attestation logistics, staggered evidence handoff & seat uplift
messages:
From: John Doe <john.doe@acme-corp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + re-attest runbook & potential seat uplift

Hi Stephanie,

Our renewal with Redwood is coming up in September and we need to re-attest SOC 2. Two asks from our side: first, we want a clear, staged runbook for evidence transfer so our security team can validate; second, we are evaluating a seat uplift and longer retention for audit logs if pricing and throughput look reasonable.

High-level constraints:
- Evidence upload window: prefer staggered small batches over 48 hours rather than one big dump (network throttling concerns)
- Hot log retention needed for 90 days, archive for 24 months for our audit readiness
- We may add ~150 concurrent seats and want an onramp plan for capacity bursts during peak ingest windows

Can you outline: staging steps, estimated time to ingest our corpus (we have ~320GB of logs), any temporary network peering requirements, and a preliminary quote that includes a committed burst option?

Thanks,
John
John Doe
Head of Security, Acme Payments
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + re-attest runbook & potential seat uplift

Hi John — thanks for the clear summary. I sketched a pragmatic, low-friction plan below and attached a short inventory template (audit_evidence_inventory.csv) to capture what your team can stage.

Proposed staging/playbook (high-level):
1) Kickoff (Day 0): Validation call (30m) to confirm data types, retention SLAs, and DR region — please confirm preferred region (us-east-1 / us-west-2).
2) Inventory + mapping (Day 1–3): you populate the inventory template and tag any PII-sensitive streams; Priyom will review for ingestion compatibility.
3) Staggered transfer (Day 4–7): we accept 12–16GB chunks every 6–8 hours (we'll provide a signed S3 endpoint and presigned URLs).
4) Ingest & verify (Day 5–10): Redwood will validate checksums and run a smoke validation; we keep a running CSV of processed manifests (log_transfer_manifest.json).
5) Attestation package (Day 10–12): we provide a bundled evidence report and sign-off checklist for your auditors.

Capacity & pricing notes:
- For the ~320GB corpus, expected baseline ingestion time (12GB per 6 hours) is ~4 days of staggered transfers. We'll prioritize small batches during your daytime windows.
- If you commit to the seat uplift (150 seats) through an annual amendment, we can include a 12% seat-credit and provide a one-time onboarding burst allowance for ingestion at no additional cost up to 600GB.
- If you prefer month-to-month, we can still enable bursts but pricing will reflect on-demand capacity rates.

Next steps: can you confirm preferred region and whether Procurement needs a draft amendment now for legal review? I copied Priyom for the technical details and Laura for commercial. I'll attach the quote (redwood-capacity-quote.pdf) once we lock the region.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme-corp.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + re-attest runbook & potential seat uplift

On Mon, Jul 14, 2025 at 11:05 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Proposed staging/playbook (high-level):
> ...

John — quick technical notes from the ingestion and compliance side:

1) Ingest throughput & network:
- We will provide presigned S3 endpoints in the region you select. For 320GB, to keep transfers smooth we recommend parallel multipart uploads with 100MB parts; this will keep individual file sizes small and reduce re-transfer on failures.
- If you have strict outbound bandwidth caps, we can accept smaller chunks over a longer window; our runtime supports resumable chunked ingestion.

2) Retention architecture:
- Hot: 90-day fast-access logs on standard object storage with read SLA.
- Cold: 24-month archive (immutable snapshot) — we write SHA256 manifests and store a signed bundle for audit.

3) Evidence sensitivity / redaction:
- For any PII fields you want redacted before upload, we can share a small redaction lambda template. If you prefer us to run redaction in-flight, that will add ~6–10% processing time.

4) Capacity onramp & burst capacity:
- For committed uplift, we allocate reserved GPU pools and reserve parallel ingestion workers; for 150 seats we recommend reserving a 1.5x burst pool for the first 30 days.

I attached the manifest template and will coordinate a short dry-run window to validate checksums.

— Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme-corp.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 16:45:00 -07:00

John — following up with commercial specifics so Procurement has something to review. Quoted numbers below are preliminary and assume us-east-1 as the region.

Commercial summary:
- Annual amendment path (recommended):
  - Additional 150 seats (committed) = $84,000/yr (unitized pricing applied).
  - 24-month archived log retention add-on = $6,500/yr.
  - One-time ingestion onboarding fee waived if amendment signed before Aug 15 (we'll include the free 600GB ingestion burst).
  - 12% credit applied to seat uplift when committed annually.

- Month-to-month path:
  - Seats = $7,500/month for the uplift (on-demand rates).
  - Retention add-on billed prorata; ingestion burst billed at on-demand burst rates.

Procurement items we can provide now: redwood-capacity-quote.pdf (attached), SOW draft, and a short amendment template for legal. If Procurement would like a single-line PO before legal countersign, we can accept that as an interim hold.

If this works, Stephanie will trigger the kickoff call and Priyom will schedule the dry-run transfer window. We can also run a short security deep-dive with your auditors next week if requested.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Commercial Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
